text:
Looking at this problem, I need to:

1. Calculate the total water units in each well (row) by summing the 1s in that row
2. For each well, determine how many bucket trips are needed by dividing the water units by the bucket capacity and rounding up (using `math.ceil`)
3. Sum up all the bucket trips across all wells to get the total number of times the buckets need to be lowered
